explainTr: Şimdi gerçek olmayan bir şeyi istemek için 'wish + past simple' kullanırız: I wish I had more time. (Aslında yok.) Be fiilinde 'were' kullanılır: I wish I were taller.
Geçmişteki pişmanlık için 'wish + had + V3': I wish I had called her. 'If only' aynı anlamdadır ama daha güçlüdür: If only I had called!
Başkasının can sıkıcı davranışının değişmesini istersen 'wish + would': I wish he would stop talking. Kendi davranışın için would kullanılmaz.
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'keşke' tek kelimedir: Keşke zamanım olsa / Keşke aramış olsaydım. İngilizcede zamana göre yapı değişir: şimdi için wish + past, geçmiş için wish + had + V3.

reading.title: A day Hafsa wished were different
reading.text:
On Wednesday afternoon, Hafsa came home from Lincoln Elementary and dropped her bag on the sofa. She was tired, and she felt something heavier than tiredness. She felt regret.

That morning, she had been a substitute in a third-grade class. The students were loud, and one boy, Jacob, kept talking during the reading lesson. Hafsa asked him politely to stop three times. He did not stop. Finally, she lost her patience and said, "Jacob, be quiet right now!" in a sharp voice. The room became silent. Jacob looked at the floor, and a few children looked frightened.

"I wish I had stayed calm," she told Linda over the fence. "I wish I hadn't shouted. I'm not that kind of teacher."

Linda listened and nodded. "Everyone has bad days. If only we could take back some words, right? But you can still fix it."

"How?"

"Apologize. Children are more forgiving than we think."

Hafsa thought about it. She wished she were more experienced. She wished the children would listen the first time. And she wished she had prepared a quiet activity for the end of the lesson. Then she realized that wishing was not enough. She opened her notebook and wrote three lines: "1. Apologize to Jacob. 2. Make a plan for noisy moments. 3. Ask Ms. Carter for advice."

The next morning, she arrived early. Jacob was already at his desk. "Jacob," she said quietly, "I'm sorry I shouted yesterday. I was impatient, and that was not fair." Jacob was surprised. "It's okay," he whispered. "I wish I hadn't talked so much."

Later, Ms. Carter heard the story and smiled. "Every new teacher has a day like that," she said. "The important thing is that you apologized. I'm grateful to have you here."

That evening, Hafsa wrote in her journal: "I wish yesterday had been different, but I am glad I learned something from it." She closed the notebook and finally felt lighter.

writing.promptTr: Öğretmen arkadaşına bir e-posta yaz: bir pişmanlığını ve şu an farklı olmasını istediğin bir şeyi anlat. En az üç wish / if only cümlesi kullan (şimdi için past simple, geçmiş için had + V3). 120-180 kelime.
writing.promptEn: Write an email to a teacher friend about something you regret and something you wish were different. Use at least three wish or if only sentences (120-180 words).
frames: Dear ..., I had a difficult day.
writing.model: Dear Ms. Carter, I had a difficult day yesterday, and I want to tell you about it. During the reading lesson, one student kept talking, and I became impatient. I shouted at him, and the whole class became silent. I wish I had stayed calm. I wish I hadn't used such a sharp voice. I felt guilty all evening. If only I were more experienced, I would know how to handle noisy moments. I also wish the children would listen the first time, but I know that is not realistic. This morning I apologized to the student, and he forgave me. I am grateful for that. I wish I had prepared a quiet activity for the end of the lesson. Next time, I will make a better plan. Could you give me some advice about classroom management? I would really appreciate it. Thank you for always being so kind and patient with me. Best wishes, Hafsa
checklistTr: En az üç wish / if only cümlen var mı?
Şimdi için wish + past simple (were), geçmiş için wish + had + V3 kullandın mı?
Wish + would'u başkasının davranışı için kullandın mı?
E-postanda selam, konu ve kapanış var mı?
